guide.title: Screen memory is off
guide.desc1: Once enabled, full-screen shots are taken at fixed intervals and OCR'd — then you can search anything that appeared on screen and jump back to that moment.
guide.desc2: Off by default; shots and text stay on the controlled machine; moments hit by privacy rules are not captured; auto-deleted after the retention window.
